title: Everything slow, no obvious cause
alert: HighLatencyP95 on payments, orders and api-gateway
query: The whole checkout path got sluggish around the same time. Nothing was deployed, the database graphs look normal and nothing is maxing out CPU. What else could it be?
root_cause: Payments responds slowly, and the delay propagates to orders and the gateway.

remediation.detail: Restart payments and investigate why charges are slow.

evidence: HighLatencyP95 fires on all three services
Payments is the slowest service in the chain
Database queries and CPU are normal and the deploy log has no recent entries
